# OpenSPP DCI API Server
Digital Convergence Initiative (DCI) API server for social registry data exchange.
## Key Features
- **DCI Protocol Compliance** - Implements DCI Connect specifications - **HTTP Signature Authentication** - Ed25519/RSA signature verification - **JWKS Support** - Public key distribution via /.well-known/jwks.json - **Search API** - POST /registry/sync/search endpoint - **Registry Sync** - Bidirectional social registry synchronization
## Endpoints
- **POST /registry/sync/search** - Search registry records - **GET /.well-known/jwks.json** - Public signing keys (JWKS format)
## Authentication
This API uses HTTP Signatures (draft-cavage-http-signatures):
1. Register your sender_id and public key with administrator 2. Sign requests using your private key 3. Include signature in request envelope 4. Server verifies signature using your registered public key

- DCI Specification: `docs/specs/dci-api-v2/SPEC.md` - Integration Guide: `docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-018-dci-api-v2.md`
